name: Holds Service Credential
description: An IAM user holds a service-specific credential (user -> credential), as the user's ListServiceSpecificCredentials names it. Containment: the credential belongs to exactly one user and goes when the user does; when a complete listing of the user no longer names it, it is a retirement candidate for its falsifier, so a deleted credential does not stay Active on the grid (aws-core-tap#282).
